structured.reason: When the tool-round limit stops the multi-round loop, the original deliberately clears output_text. The mutant lets build_public_response fall back to its default, which normally copies the provider's text, so the public response carries partial text instead of an empty result. That changes what the bounded orchestration returns when a multi-round workflow is cut short rather than finished with a final response.

Execute local tools through a bounded public orchestration contract
